front.title: Agent Execution Evidence: A SCITT Profile for Verifiable Records of AI Agent Runs

abstract.t: AI agents act through calls to models, tools and other agents. Identity work establishes who an agent is and what it may do, but leaves execution-evidence formats and assurance criteria out of scope. This document profiles the Supply Chain Integrity, Transparency, and Trust (SCITT) architecture for Signed Statements that bind an agent's registered identity, declared capabilities, risk-based assessment and supervised operational status to a hash- chained record of every call the agent makes. It also defines admission records produced where a call is received, and the linking of records for requests that pass between agents of different operators. It specifies Registration Policy, offline verification and Bundle requirements. It does not define an accreditation scheme, a universal risk classification, an identifier scheme or a policy language.
